briefing.text: Recommendation: GRIT TONIGHT. 20 of 33 routes are forecast to reach icy-road conditions. First truck should leave at 03:15 (N16). Coldest route is R190 with a forecast road surface minimum of -3.8 C. 20 routes are flagged REVIEW because the rules engine and the trained model disagree. Confidence is LOW: the rules engine and the trained model disagree on many routes, so check the flagged routes. This is a recommendation only. The Duty Engineer makes the final decision.

S1.name: Open-Meteo forecast API
S1.what: hourly air temp, dew point, precipitation, cloud, wind at 22 grid cells

S2.name: OpenStreetMap (Overpass)
S2.what: trunk/primary/secondary roads in County Cavan with ref tags; routes built by grouping on ref

S3.name: ERA5 / ERA5-Land via Open-Meteo archive
S3.what: 7 winters Oct 2018 - Mar 2025, used for backtest and model training

S4.name: Copernicus DEM via Open-Meteo elevation API
S4.what: route elevation sampled about every 1 km

S5.name: Winter Watch rules engine
S5.what: lapse-rate adjustment, road surface estimate, GO/MARGINAL/NO-GO thresholds (see thresholds)
